blocks.content: Source Code: Find Maximum in a Circular Linked List

1def find_max(self):
2    # empty circular linked list has no head
3    if not self.head:
4        return None
5
6    # start with head
7    current = self.head
8    # assign first value as maximum
9    maximum = current.data
10
11    while current.next is not self.head:
12        current = current.next
13        if current.data > maximum:
14            maximum = current.data
15
16    return maximum
